changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[GetArtifactChildByAssetID] ( @Id bigint ) returns table as return ( select A.ID as ID, A.ObjectID as ObjectID, IA.ObjectID as ChildID, ID.DisplayValue as ChildDisplayValue, IAT.[ObjectID] as ChildArtifactTypeID, IAT.Name as ChildArtifactTypeName from Asset A inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.SubjectAssetID = A.ID inner join dbo.[IntersectType] IT on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join dbo.[Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 inner join dbo.Asset IA on IA.ID = I.ObjectAssetID inner join AssetDisplayValue ID on ID.AssetID = IA.ID inner join dbo.AssetType IAT on IAT.ID = IA.AssetTypeID where A.[Object] = 'Artifact' and A.ID = @Id )
changeSet.rollback: create or alter function [dbo].[GetArtifactChildByAssetID] ( @Id bigint ) returns table as return ( select A.ID as ID, A.ObjectID as ObjectID, I.SubjectID as ChildID, ID.DisplayValue as ChildDisplayValue, IAT.[ObjectID] as ChildArtifactTypeID, IAT.Name as ChildArtifactTypeName from Asset A inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.SubjectAssetID = A.ID inner join dbo.[IntersectType] IT on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join dbo.[Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 inner join dbo.Asset IA on IA.ID = I.ObjectAssetID inner join AssetDisplayValue ID on ID.AssetID = IA.ID inner join dbo.AssetType IAT on IAT.ID = IA.AssetTypeID where A.[Object] = 'Artifact' and A.ID = @Id )
